message: What's the purpose of

name: Synn
message: 「Brrr... It's freezing」

name: Paqy
message: 「Then why don't you just hurry on home」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I was wondering what to get Macaron for Christmas」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ahh, so that's why she's not with you today」

name: Synn
message: 「Macaron's at her part-time job, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gotcha」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, knowing that little squirt, she'll be happy with whatever she gets if it's from the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「You say that, but...」
Even so, I still want to give her the gift that'll make her the happiest.

name: Synn
message: 「What would be good...」
I wander aimlessly through the shopping district.

name: Synn
message: 「Hm, what's that...」
Suddenly, my eyes catch the storefront of Ponpoko.

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Tame-san」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Synn. What brings you here today?」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure I can have these lights and tree sets for free?」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Yeah, they're the ones we used in the shopping district up until last year, and getting rid of 'em is a hassle」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, they were replaced with new ones this year」

name: Tame-san
message: 「Take as much as you want, I don't mind」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much」

name: Tame-san
message: 「You gonna decorate your house or something?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, something like that」
I might have just come up with a good idea.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh? Hey, it's Synn」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yoohoo, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, you two. You look like you've got time on your hands」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I told you, that's not true~ I'm super busy~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin and I are just heading over to Chocolat now」

name: Synn
message: 「Another cake binge?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sweets!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mako-chan said she's working part-time there, you know. Plus it's part of our club activities」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right?」
Man, Macaron picked up another part-time job?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I was the one who referred her, though」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that supposed to mean」

name: Sacchin
message: 「They say it's really busy around this time of year~」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, Sacchin aside, you should get a part-time job too, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm busy helping out at home and stuff, you know」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I feel like I just got treated subtly unfairly~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Anyway, since we're going, why don't you come with us, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I don't really have any money though~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is that because you bought that piece of junk?」

name: Synn
message: 「I've been broke from the start. Tame-san gave me this. It still works, too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm. Well, just coming into the shop shouldn't be a problem, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, yeah~」

name: Synn
message: 「Got it. Then I'll just tag along as Great Master Nanaka's attendant」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahaha. Well then, shall we go?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah~♪」
After that, while watching Macaron work her shift at Chocolat.
And letting Nanaka and the others' sweets talk go in one ear and out the other.
Before I knew it, it was already time for Macaron's shift to end...

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Macaron-san, thank you for your hard work today」

name: Macaron
message: 「Not at all! Thank you so much for having us!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahaha... Sorry for sticking around so late like this」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Please don't mind it at all. After all, you are always such regular patrons」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Coming three times a week isn't just for show, huh~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's coming way too often...」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Oh, that reminds me, Macaron-san」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Please take this and enjoy it together, everyone」

name: Macaron
message: 「What is it?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa, it's a cake~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And a super fancy one at that!」

name: Synn
message: 「A-A-Are you sure it's really okay for us to accept this?!」

name: Fuyuka
message: 「Yes. It's a little early, so think of it as a Christmas present from me」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ooh!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Thank you very muuuch!」
After that, we parted ways with Nanaka and the others in the shopping district.
I walk the road home together with Macaron.

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihehe... That was awesome, big brother」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. There's enough for Sally-chan and Paqy too, so let's all eat it when we get back」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Scoring a Christmas cake for free--just as expected of the Demon Lord」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't go there intending to do that」

name: Macaron
message: 「Since you insulted big brother, no cake for Paqy-sama!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Daaah, that's cruel! Let the great me have some too!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then I'll give you this chocolate decoration. Lucky you~」

name: Paqy
message: 「That just makes it even more pathetic...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wrapping the Great Sage around your finger--that's our Macaron」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, well, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, why did you pick up more shifts all of a sudden?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm... No reason」

name: Synn
message: 「'No reason,' she says...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because I heard things were busy」

name: Macaron
message: 「I just couldn't leave someone in trouble alone. That's all」

name: Synn
message: 「I see」

name: Macaron
message: 「What about you, big brother? What's with that trash?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, nothing really」

name: Macaron
message: 「Aah! What's that, no fair!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well then, shall we hurry home and eat some cake?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, wait up, big brother!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, if I run, the cake will get ruined」

name: Macaron
message: 「Dummy!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Both of you are terrible at keeping secrets」
